description: Nuxt adds page routing and project tools to Vue. This starter course builds a small site from pages and shared layouts. It uses local content and a static build, so the finished sample does not need a login or a database. Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.
versionNote: Targets Nuxt 3 directory conventions, Vue 3 and static generation.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to add pages/about.vue with a short club description
Learn to render two BookCard components with different titles
Learn to open the moon-trip route and inspect the shown slug
